name: theultimate-dev
description: Agent skills Igor Wnek uses every day, grouped into categories. Open Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: foundations
plugins.description: What every project needs regardless of stack: decision records that people and agents can read, and releases with a changelog and a tag on main.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: From rough ideas to product/design handoffs: requirements, UX flows, visual directions, and independent offline HTML prototypes, with an optional discovery coordinator.

plugins.name: product-engineering
plugins.description: One implementation loop from a work item to merged pull requests: you are interviewed, pick an approach, agree the verification method and approve the roadmap; the agent then implements, verifies in the running app, reviews with five parallel lenses, and merges the PRs it may merge.

plugins.name: prompt-engineering
plugins.description: From a rough prompt to an engineered one: destination and gap diagnosis, a catalog of prompt and context engineering techniques with apply and reject criteria, dated model-family notes, and a copy-paste-ready result with the reasoning behind it.
